 What's open and closed on Veterans Day 2026 
 By ABC Digital Staff Tuesday, November 10, 2026 11:58PM 
 Here's where you can find discounts and deals this Veterans Day if you're active, non-active or retired military personnel. Veterans Day will be celebrated nationwide this coming Wednesday, Nov. 11.
 The holiday honors active and former U.S. service members and is one of 11 of the United States' federal holidays. This means that all non-essential government agencies will be closed on Wednesday. Here's what else will be closed on Veterans Day this year.
 What's open and closed on Veterans Day 2026
 Are banks open on Veterans Day?
 Most banks will be closed on Veterans Day, including JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America and Wells Fargo. However, customers can still utilize ATMs or online banking services.
 The New York Stock Exchange and Nasdaq will be open. The Federal Reserve is closed.
 Is the post office open on Veterans Day?
 A customer walks into a FedEx store. Brandon Bell/Getty Images 
 The United States Post Office will be closed on Veterans Day.
 FedEx Office locations will be open, although Fedex shipping services will have modified service, with the exception of FedEx Custom Critical.
 Meanwhile, UPS Store locations will operate normal hours, and UPS pickup and delivery services will be available. However, the shipping service notes that SurePost and Mail Innovations deliveries will require an additional business day's time in transit due to the holiday.
 Is the DMV open on Veterans Day?
 Most government institutions, including DMVs, public schools and local libraries will be closed. Make sure to double-check if your local services are open that day.
 What about national parks?
 Veterans Day is a great time to visit a national park with entrance fees waived for U.S. citizens and residents who visit on the holiday.

 What stores are open on Veterans Day?
 Many retail stores such as Costco, Target, Walmart and Kroger will be open on Veterans Day. Make sure to check with local stores and retailers for alternate hours.
